notes.note: Single-stock sense of 'saham' rendered JA 銘柄 / KO 종목 (here and rows 1, 32, 170) for naturalness; 'shares' stays 株 / 주식 as in the glossary.
'breakdown' (and 'menembus/ditembus support'): EN breakdown / ZH 跌破 / JA 下抜け / KO 하향 이탈 throughout (rows 71-122), per the 22 Oct consistency pass (was ブレイクダウン / 하향 돌파).
'retest' not in glossary; used ZH 回踩 / JA リテスト / KO 리테스트.
'volume spike' not in glossary; used ZH 成交量激增 / JA 出来高の急増 / KO 거래량 급증. Also: profit taking = 获利了结 / 利益確定売り / 차익 실현; panic selling = 恐慌性抛售 / パニック売り / 패닉 매도; pullback = 回调 / 押し目 / 눌림목.
